subject: Welcome — book a short walkthrough to see Redwood in action
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Self-serve signup — interested in a quick walkthrough

Hi Hannah,

I just completed a trial signup on Redwood and poked around the quickstart. We're evaluating inference platforms for a mixed workload (batch embeddings + low-latency chat for our analytics UI). I'm based in EST (UTC-5) and would love a short 20–30 minute walkthrough focused on latency tuning and cost controls.

Rough windows that work for me this week:
- Tue 1:00–3:00 PM EST
- Wed 10:00–11:30 AM EST

If you have a template NDA or a one-pager on hosting/private deployment, feel free to attach. Also happy to use whatever scheduling flow you prefer.

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Platform Engineer, Acme Analytics
evansmobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve signup — interested in a quick walkthrough

Hi Evan — welcome and thanks for signing up!

I'm Hannah on the SDR team — quick note to get you in front of an engineer for the exact things you mentioned. You can pick a 15- or 30-minute slot on my calendar here: https://cal.redwood.ai/hannah/15min (bookings show in your local timezone).

If you'd rather propose one of the windows you mentioned, I put Karthik (our technical SDR) on cc and he can take the meeting if you'd prefer a deeper latency/cost conversation.

Attached: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (short overview) and a brief export of your signup (acme-signup-summary.json) so we have context.

If you have any compliance or deployment questions (VPC/on-prem), let us know up front and we'll pull in an engineer.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[attachment: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf]

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2029 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve signup — interested in a quick walkthrough

Thanks, Hannah — I grabbed a tentative slot via the calendar link for Wed 11:00 AM EST (which should be Wed 08:00 AM PDT per the booking UI). That works for me.

Two quick asks so the call is productive:
- Can we focus the first 10 minutes on latency behavior for short sequences (<=128 tokens) and tail p99s?
- If you have a short note on pricing for low-volume private deployments, that would help (we're thinking about a pilot).

If Karthik is available and prefers the deep-dive, happy to have him lead.

—Evan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Jul 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve signup — interested in a quick walkthrough

Hi Evan — thanks for booking, and great notes. Confirming our 30-minute walkthrough:

When: Wed, 31 Jul 2029 11:00 AM EDT / 8:00 AM PDT (30 minutes)
Where: Google Meet (link below)
Agenda (30 min):
- 5 min intros and goals
- 10 min latency profile & p99/tail behavior on short sequences
- 10 min cost levers (batching, caching, quantization recommendations)
- 5 min next steps & pilot checklist

Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rdw-acme-demo
Attachments: acme-intake-notes.pdf (we added your signup details and the agenda).

If you'd like to push to 45 minutes, we can — just say the word. Otherwise we'll keep it focused and follow up with a prioritized pilot checklist. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Technical SDR | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0246
